column1: Does this X-ray have tuberculosis? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1, "BOUNDING_BOX": [x_topleft, y_topleft, x_bottomright, y_bottomright], "LOCATION": "left lung" or "right lung" or "lung upper lobe left" or "lung upper lobe right" or "lung lower lobe left" or "lung lower lobe right"}
Does it have the ET Tube and what is the distance between the Carina and the ET Tube? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1, "DISTANCE": FLOAT}
